meta.title: Fernhollow Library: Book Loans
meta.subtitle: How a book leaves the shelf, comes back, and who gets told.

lines.name: Loan line
lines.role: A member finds a book and borrows it.

lines.name: Hold line
lines.role: A book already out is requested and held.

lines.name: Return line
lines.role: A book comes back and reaches the shelf.

lines.name: Reminder line
lines.role: A late loan produces a reminder.

nodes.label: Member
nodes.note: Anyone holding a Fernhollow library card.

nodes.label: Catalogue search
nodes.note: Members look up a title on the website or the lobby terminals.

nodes.label: Card check
nodes.note: Confirms the card is valid before a loan is allowed.

nodes.label: Checkout kiosk
nodes.note: Scans the card and the book, then records the loan.

nodes.label: Loan ledger
nodes.note: One row per loan: member, book, date out, date due, date back.

nodes.label: Due-date receipt
nodes.note: Printed at the kiosk. States the due date, 21 days after the loan.

nodes.label: Catalogue database
nodes.note: Every title and copy, with its current shelf location.

nodes.label: Hold queue
nodes.note: Requests for books that are out, oldest first.

nodes.label: Hold shelf
nodes.note: Reserved copies wait here for seven days.

nodes.label: Return bin
nodes.note: A slot in the front wall, open all hours.

nodes.label: Return scanner
nodes.note: A volunteer scans each book each morning.

nodes.label: Sorting cart
nodes.note: Returned books wait here to be sorted by section.

nodes.label: Open shelves
nodes.note: The physical collection on the two public floors.

nodes.label: Overdue check
nodes.note: Runs each night and finds loans past their due date.

nodes.label: Reminder sender
nodes.note: Writes the reminder message for each late loan.

nodes.label: Message provider
nodes.basis: Does the reminder go by email, by text or both, and who supplies the service?

nodes.label: Fee account
nodes.basis: The brief says cards with unpaid fees are blocked, so fees must be held somewhere per member.

nodes.label: Circulation desk
nodes.note: Two staff members who can override a blocked card.

nodes.label: Monthly loan report
nodes.basis: The board reviews loan counts monthly, which suggests a report drawn from the ledger.

nodes.label: Partner libraries
nodes.basis: Can a hold be filled by another library, and how would that book be tracked?

edges.basis: Does the reminder go by email, by text or both, and who supplies the service?

edges.label: Location updated
edges.basis: A catalogue that shows shelf location must be updated when books return.
The card check blocks unpaid fees, so it must read the balance.
Loan counts can only come from the ledger.

edges.label: A returned copy fills a hold
edges.basis: Holds wait for a free copy, and returns are the only source named.
Can a hold be filled by another library, and how would that book be tracked?
